records.claim: In the RASolute-302 phase 3 trial, daraxonrasib roughly doubled median overall survival versus chemotherapy in RAS G12-mutant second-line metastatic pancreatic cancer (13.2 vs 6.6 months, HR 0.40).
records.quote: In patients harboring RAS G12 mutations, daraxonrasib virtually doubled median OS to 13.2 months compared to 6.6 months in the chemotherapy arm (HR 0.40, 95% CI 0.30–0.54; p < 0.001).
records.source: Pillozzi S et al., The KRAS targeting revolution in metastatic pancreatic cancer: insights from RASolute-302 and allele-specific strategies at ASCO 2026, J Hematol Oncol, 2026-08-08 (secondary review of the trial)

records.claim: In the overall RASolute-302 population (500 patients, second line) median OS was 13.2 vs 6.7 months, HR 0.40, so daraxonrasib is the benchmark a G12D-only drug must beat in second-line pancreatic cancer.
records.quote: Median Overall Survival (OS) | 13.2 months | 6.7 months | HR = 0.40 (95% CI 0.30-0-53) p<0.001
records.source: Pillozzi S et al., J Hematol Oncol, 2026-08-08, Table 1 (overall population)

records.claim: A registered randomised (1:1) phase 3 study (title: GFH375 versus chemotherapy) enrols previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer with centrally confirmed KRAS G12D; recruiting, start 2025-12-04.
records.quote: This study plans to enroll participants with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer and harbor centrally confirmed KRAS G12D mutation.
records.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07262567, Phase III Study to Compare GFH375 and Chemotherapy in Patients With KRAS G12D-Mutant Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer

seed_checks.seed_claim: GFH375 showed a 41% response rate at 600 mg in 66 patients in China.
seed_checks.paperclip: Searches of abstracts/pmc/biorxiv/medrxiv for GFH375 + response rate/600 mg/China returned no clinical result text; only preclinical abstract (Cancer Res 2024 84:3318, cited in PMC11240577) and PMC11789494 mention GFH375.
seed_checks.correction: Unverified. The 41%, 600 mg, n=66 figures are not in anything Paperclip returned. Registry NCT07026916 (phase II, previously treated KRAS G12D mPDAC) exists but gives no results. Needs the ASCO/ESMO 2025 abstract or company release.

seed_checks.seed_claim: VS-7375: the 900 mg dose separates from 600 mg; 13 of 14 patients had CA19-9 responses.
seed_checks.paperclip: Search 'VS-7375 900 mg CA19-9' found only PMC13287896 (The Oncologist 2026-06-23, trial-in-progress for Phase 1/2 in cholangiocarcinoma, no results read) and AACR RAS abstract oa_W7133932439 (preclinical). No dose-separation or CA19-9 data found.
seed_checks.correction: Unverified. Likely a Verastem press release/corporate deck, not indexed. Do not cite until the primary source is read.

seed_checks.seed_claim: GenFleet is running a Phase 3 of GFH375 against chemotherapy in second-line pancreatic cancer (KYLIN-WINGS).
seed_checks.quote: This study plans to enroll participants with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer and harbor centrally confirmed KRAS G12D mutation.
seed_checks.paperclip: /trials/NCT07262567/content.lines L1; meta.json: recruiting, start 2025-12-04, title 'Phase III Study to Compare GFH375 and Chemotherapy in Patients With KRAS G12D-Mutant Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer'
seed_checks.correction: Phase 3 GFH375 vs chemotherapy exists (NCT07262567, randomised 1:1, previously treated, one prior fluorouracil/gemcitabine regimen). The text read does not name the sponsor or the name 'KYLIN-WINGS' (a 'KYLIN' grep of trials hit nothing relevant). Keep the trial, drop the name and sponsor attribution until confirmed. Also NCT07644559 is a separate Verastem Phase 2 of VS-7375 (+/- cetuximab) in KRAS G12D pancreatic cancer.

seed_checks.seed_claim: Daraxonrasib nearly doubled survival against chemotherapy in previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer (RASolute 302), hazard ratio 0.40.
seed_checks.quote: In patients harboring RAS G12 mutations, daraxonrasib virtually doubled median OS to 13.2 months compared to 6.6 months in the chemotherapy arm (HR 0.40, 95% CI 0.30–0.54; p < 0.001).
seed_checks.paperclip: /papers/PMC13453085/content.lines L13 and L22 (overall population HR 0.40, 13.2 vs 6.7 months); also PMC13354352 (2026-06-03)
seed_checks.correction: Confirmed via secondary peer-reviewed reviews only; the primary trial paper/FDA record was not found in this run. Specify population: HR 0.40 holds in both the RAS G12 group and overall population.
